tasks.title: Decode a FAT Directory Entry
tasks.description: Given a hex dump of a FAT32 directory entry, decode the file name, attributes, starting cluster, file size, and determine if it is deleted.

tasks.title: Analyze an NTFS MFT Record
tasks.description: Examine a hex snippet of an MFT file record, identify attributes, recover the file name, and determine if the data is resident.
